cases.expected: Num value returned by underlying MMAIndicator (e.g., DecimalNum.valueOf(12.34))
cases.description: When a valid index is supplied, getValue should delegate to averageTrueRangeIndicator and return the same Num value.
If a negative index is provided, the underlying MMAIndicator is expected to throw IndexOutOfBoundsException, which should propagate from getValue.
When the index exceeds the bar count of the series, the underlying MMAIndicator should throw IndexOutOfBoundsException, and getValue must propagate it.

cases.expected: verify that averageTrueRangeIndicator.getValue(3) is called exactly once
cases.description: Ensures that getValue forwards the call to the internal MMAIndicator with the exact same index and does not invoke it multiple times.

cases.expected: Num value returned by underlying MMAIndicator for the first bar (e.g., DecimalNum.valueOf(1.23))
cases.description: Verify that getValue correctly delegates to the underlying MMAIndicator when the index is the first valid position (0) and returns the exact Num instance.

cases.expected: Num value returned by underlying MMAIndicator for the last valid bar (e.g., DecimalNum.valueOf(9.87))
cases.description: When the index equals series.getBarCount() - 1, getValue should delegate to the MMAIndicator and return its Num value without throwing.
If the index equals series.getBarCount() (i.e., one past the last valid bar), the underlying MMAIndicator should throw IndexOutOfBoundsException which must propagate.
